:::{#def-transitive}
#### Transitive relation

Let $\sim$ be a [relation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-relation) on a set $S$.
The relation $\sim$ is **transitive**
[@wikipedia_transitive_relation]
if,
for all $a, b, c \in S$,
$a \sim b$ and $b \sim c$ together imply $a \sim c$.

:::
